# Register reference {#registers}

This appendix lists the registers of the LiteDRAM cores: DFI injector, PHYs, controller
options and frontends. It is generated from the register definitions of the gateware,
elaborated on six configurations without running an FPGA toolchain. Offsets are in bytes
from the base of the bank; the base addresses depend on the SoC and are in the `csr.csv`
of a build. In the table below, `key=value` is a key of the example changed for the
appendix, and `ECC AXI port` replaces the user ports with one AXI port with ECC.

| Configuration | Target and options |
|------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| `arty` | `gen` `examples/arty.yml` |
| `xcu1525` | `gen` `examples/xcu1525.yml` |
| `versa_ecp5` | `gen` `examples/versa_ecp5.yml` |
| `tang_mega_138k_pro` | `gen` `examples/tang_mega_138k_pro.yml` |
| `xcu1525_ecc` | `gen` `examples/xcu1525.yml` `sdram_module_nb=9` `with_ecc=True` `with_ecc_bit_stats=True` `with_bandwidth=True` `with_hpio_vref=True` `ECC AXI port` |
| `genesys2_bist` | `bench/genesys2` `--with-bist` |

Access is `rw` for a register written by software (`CSRStorage`), `ro` for a status
(`CSRStatus`) and `wo` for a write-only strobe (`CSR`). The reset value of a `rw`
register ends its description. A register wider than 32 bits takes several
32-bit words of the bus, most significant word first. The BIOS and the host tools use these names through
the generated `csr.h` and `csr.csv`, so they rarely need the offsets.

## Generator control {#reg-ddrctrl}

Defined by `LiteDRAMCoreControl` (`litedram/gen.py`).

Built by the generator only (`litedram_gen`); a LiteX SoC has no such bank. The
firmware writes `init_done` at the end of the initialization, and `init_error` too when
it failed. The generated core drives its `init_done` and `init_error` outputs from them,
and its user ports wait for `init_done` by default ([Integration](#integration)).

Bank `ddrctrl`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `init_done` | `0x0000` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `init_error` | `0x0004` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |

## DFI injector {#reg-sdram-dfii}

Defined by `DFIInjector` (`litedram/dfii.py`).

The registers of the DFI injector are in the `sdram` bank, so their full names start
with `sdram_dfii_`. Each DFI phase has a group of six `pi<n>_` registers, `0x18` bytes
apart: the table shows phase 0, the 1:4 PHYs have four groups and the 1:2 PHYs two. The
`sel` field of `control` gives the DFI to the controller (`1`, at reset) or to software
(`0`). Software writes a command into `pi<n>_command` and pulses `pi<n>_command_issue`;
[Initialization and calibration](#calibration) describes how the BIOS uses them.

Bank `sdram_dfii`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `control` | `0x0000` | 4 | rw | Control DFI signals common to all phases Reset `0x1`. |
| `pi0_command` | `0x0004` | 8 | rw | Control DFI signals on a single phase Reset `0x0`. |
| `pi0_command_` `issue` | `0x0008` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `pi0_address` | `0x000c` | 14 | rw | DFI address bus Reset `0x0`. |
| `pi0_baddress` | `0x0010` | 3 | rw | DFI bank address bus Reset `0x0`. |
| `pi0_wrdata` | `0x0014` | 32 | rw | DFI write data bus Reset `0x0`. |
| `pi0_rddata` | `0x0018` | 32 | ro | DFI read data bus |

Fields of `control`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `sel` | 0 |  |
| `cke` | 1 | DFI clock enable bus |
| `odt` | 2 | DFI on-die termination bus |
| `reset_n` | 3 | DFI clock reset bus |

Fields of `pi0_command`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `cs` | 0 | DFI chip select bus |
| `we` | 1 | DFI write enable bus |
| `cas` | 2 | DFI column address strobe bus |
| `ras` | 3 | DFI row address strobe bus |
| `wren` | 4 | DFI write data enable bus |
| `rden` | 5 | DFI read data enable bus |
| `cs_top` | 6 | DFI chip select bus for top half only |
| `cs_bottom` | 7 | DFI chip select bus for bottom half only |

## Artix-7 PHY {#reg-ddrphy-a7}

Defined by `A7DDRPHY` (`litedram/phy/s7ddrphy.py`).

Every PHY has a `ddrphy` bank. The appendix lists it under one name per family only to
keep the families apart; in a build, the full names start with `ddrphy_`. The
registers have the same meaning in every family that has them:

| Registers | Role |
|------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `rst` | Reset of the PHY, pulsed by the BIOS before the initialization |
| `dly_sel` | One bit per byte group: the groups that the delay and bitslip strobes act on |
| `rdly_dq_rst`, `rdly_dq_inc` | Reset or step the read delay of the selected groups |
| `rdly_dq_bitslip_rst`, `rdly_dq_bitslip` | Reset or step the read bitslip of the selected groups |
| `wdly_dq_bitslip_rst`, `wdly_dq_bitslip` | Reset or step the write bitslip of the selected groups |
| `wlevel_en`, `wlevel_strobe` | Write leveling mode, and one DQS pulse in that mode |
| `half_sys8x_taps` | Delay taps in a quarter of tCK; the BIOS derives the tCK taps from it |
| `rdphase`, `wrphase` | DFI phase of the read and write commands |

The Artix-7 PHY has no ODELAY, so it has no write delay registers.

Bank `ddrphy_a7`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `rst` | `0x0000` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `dly_sel` | `0x0004` | 2 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `half_sys8x_taps` | `0x0008` | 5 | rw | Reset `0x8`. |
| `wlevel_en` | `0x000c` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `wlevel_strobe` | `0x0010` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_rst` | `0x0014` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_inc` | `0x0018` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_` `bitslip_rst` | `0x001c` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_bitslip` | `0x0020` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dq_` `bitslip_rst` | `0x0024` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dq_bitslip` | `0x0028` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdphase` | `0x002c` | 2 | rw | Reset `0x3`. |
| `wrphase` | `0x0030` | 2 | rw | Reset `0x3`. |

## Kintex-7 PHY {#reg-ddrphy-k7}

Defined by `K7DDRPHY` (`litedram/phy/s7ddrphy.py`).

The Kintex-7 and Virtex-7 PHYs with ODELAY add the delays of write leveling: `cdly_`
for the clock and command lines, `wdly_dq_` and `wdly_dqs_` for the data and strobes
of the selected groups. Built with `with_odelay=False`, they have the bank of the
Artix-7 PHY.

Bank `ddrphy_k7`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `rst` | `0x0000` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `dly_sel` | `0x0004` | 4 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `half_sys8x_taps` | `0x0008` | 5 | rw | Reset `0x6`. |
| `wlevel_en` | `0x000c` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `wlevel_strobe` | `0x0010` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `cdly_rst` | `0x0014` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `cdly_inc` | `0x0018` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_rst` | `0x001c` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_inc` | `0x0020` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_` `bitslip_rst` | `0x0024` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_bitslip` | `0x0028` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dq_rst` | `0x002c` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dq_inc` | `0x0030` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dqs_rst` | `0x0034` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dqs_inc` | `0x0038` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dq_` `bitslip_rst` | `0x003c` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dq_bitslip` | `0x0040` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdphase` | `0x0044` | 2 | rw | Reset `0x1`. |
| `wrphase` | `0x0048` | 2 | rw | Reset `0x2`. |

## UltraScale+ PHY {#reg-ddrphy-usp}

Defined by `USPDDRPHY` (`litedram/phy/usddrphy.py`).

The UltraScale and UltraScale+ PHYs read back the delays they set (`cdly_value`,
`wdly_dqs_inc_count`, `half_sys8x_taps`). The BIOS clears `en_vtc` while it has
software control of the DFI, so that the voltage and temperature compensation does not
move the delays during leveling. `rd_vref` exists only with `with_hpio_vref` (DDR4 on
UltraScale+, `xcu1525_ecc`).

Bank `ddrphy_usp`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `rst` | `0x0000` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `en_vtc` | `0x0004` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x1`. |
| `half_sys8x_taps` | `0x0008` | 9 | ro | No description. |
| `wlevel_en` | `0x000c` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `wlevel_strobe` | `0x0010` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `cdly_rst` | `0x0014` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `cdly_inc` | `0x0018` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `cdly_value` | `0x001c` | 9 | ro | No description. |
| `dly_sel` | `0x0020` | 9 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `rdly_dq_rst` | `0x0024` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_inc` | `0x0028` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_` `bitslip_rst` | `0x002c` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_bitslip` | `0x0030` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dq_rst` | `0x0034` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dq_inc` | `0x0038` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dqs_rst` | `0x003c` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dqs_inc` | `0x0040` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dqs_inc_` `count` | `0x0044` | 9 | ro | No description. |
| `wdly_dq_` `bitslip_rst` | `0x0048` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `wdly_dq_bitslip` | `0x004c` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdphase` | `0x0050` | 2 | rw | Reset `0x2`. |
| `wrphase` | `0x0054` | 2 | rw | Reset `0x2`. |
| `rd_vref` | `0x0058` | 7 | rw | Reset `0x1f`. |

## ECP5 PHY {#reg-ddrphy-ecp5}

Defined by `ECP5DDRPHY` (`litedram/phy/ecp5ddrphy.py`).

`burstdet_seen` has one bit per byte group, set when the PHY saw a read burst on its
strobe since `burstdet_clr`; the BIOS reads it during read leveling. The 1:4 wrapper
with `rate_crossing` adds a `rate` register, not used by the BIOS.

Bank `ddrphy_ecp5`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `dly_sel` | `0x0000` | 2 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `rdly_dq_rst` | `0x0004` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_inc` | `0x0008` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_` `bitslip_rst` | `0x000c` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_bitslip` | `0x0010` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `burstdet_clr` | `0x0014` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `burstdet_seen` | `0x0018` | 2 | ro | No description. |

## Gowin GW5A PHY {#reg-ddrphy-gw5}

Defined by `GW5DDRPHY` (`litedram/phy/gw5ddrphy.py`).

The GW5A PHY at 1:2, as in the example. `rdly_dq_dir` sets the direction of the read
delay steps. At 1:4 with the DLL on, the PHY adds `wdly_dq_rst`, `wdly_dq_inc` and
`wdly_dq_dir`. The GW2A PHY has the bank of this table.

Bank `ddrphy_gw5`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `dly_sel` | `0x0000` | 2 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `rdly_dq_rst` | `0x0004` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_inc` | `0x0008` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_dir` | `0x000c` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `rdly_dq_` `bitslip_rst` | `0x0010` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `rdly_dq_bitslip` | `0x0014` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `burstdet_clr` | `0x0018` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `burstdet_seen` | `0x001c` | 2 | ro | No description. |

## Bandwidth monitor {#reg-sdram-controller-bandwidth}

Defined by `Bandwidth` (`litedram/core/bandwidth.py`).

Present with `with_bandwidth` (a `ControllerSettings` key). The registers are in the
`sdram` bank (full names `sdram_controller_bandwidth_<register>`). A write to `update`
copies the read and write commands counted over the last period of 2^24 cycles into
`nreads` and `nwrites`; `data_width` is the controller data width in bits.

Bank `sdram_controller_bandwidth`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `update` | `0x00e4` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `nreads` | `0x00e8` | 25 | ro | No description. |
| `nwrites` | `0x00ec` | 25 | ro | No description. |
| `data_width` | `0x00f0` | 10 | ro | No description. |

## DFI ECC {#reg-sdram-ecc}

Defined by `LiteDRAMDFIECC` (`litedram/core/ecc.py`).

Present with `with_ecc` on a 72-bit memory (`xcu1525_ecc`: nine byte groups). The
registers are in the `sdram` bank (full names `sdram_ecc_<register>`); `bitsel` and
`bitcnt` exist only with `with_ecc_bit_stats`. A write to `clear` resets the counters.

Bank `sdram_ecc`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `enable` | `0x00f4` | 1 | rw | Correct single-bit errors. Reset `0x1`. |
| `clear` | `0x00f8` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `sec` | `0x00fc` | 32 | ro | Beats with a corrected single-bit error. |
| `ded` | `0x0100` | 32 | ro | Beats with a detected double-bit error. |
| `bitsel` | `0x0104` | 7 | rw | DQ bit whose counter `bitcnt` shows (0-71). Reset `0x0`. |
| `bitcnt` | `0x0108` | 32 | ro | Corrected single-bit errors on DQ `bitsel`. |

## Port ECC {#reg-ecc}

Defined by `LiteDRAMNativePortECC` (`litedram/frontend/ecc.py`).

One bank per user port with `ecc: true` in a generator configuration, named
`ecc_<port name>` (`ecc_axi_0` here). `sec_errors` and `ded_errors` count the
corrected and the detected errors; a write to `clear` resets them.

Bank `ecc_axi_0`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `enable` | `0x0000` | 1 | rw | Reset `0x1`. |
| `clear` | `0x0004` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `sec_errors` | `0x0008` | 32 | ro | No description. |
| `ded_errors` | `0x000c` | 32 | ro | No description. |

## BIST generator {#reg-sdram-generator}

Defined by `LiteDRAMBISTGenerator` (`litedram/frontend/bist.py`).

Present with `with_bist` (`add_sdram(with_bist=True)`, the `--with-bist` option of the
bench targets, `litex_sim --with-sdram-bist`). `base` and `end` are byte addresses,
`length` a number of bytes; `ticks` is the duration of the last run in clock cycles.
The BIOS commands `sdram_bist` and `sdram_hw_test` exist only with both BIST banks.

Bank `sdram_generator`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `reset` | `0x0000` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `start` | `0x0004` | 1 | wo | Write strobe. |
| `done` | `0x0008` | 1 | ro | No description. |
| `base` | `0x000c` | 30 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `end` | `0x0010` | 30 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `length` | `0x0014` | 30 | rw | Reset `0x0`. |
| `random` | `0x0018` | 2 | rw | See the fields below. Reset `0x0`. |
| `ticks` | `0x001c` | 32 | ro | No description. |

Fields of `random`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `data` | 0 |  |
| `addr` | 1 |  |
